description: NaGaCl₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic P2_12_12₁ space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven Cl atoms. There are a spread of Na-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.79-3.28 Å. Ga is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four Cl atoms. There are a spread of Ga-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.18-2.20 Å. There are four inequivalent Cl sites. In the first Cl site, Cl is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one Ga atom. In the second Cl site, Cl is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and one Ga atom. In the third Cl site, Cl is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one Ga atom. In the fourth Cl site, Cl is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one Ga atom.
